product_name.label: Product name
product_name.what: Commercial name of the product as printed on its documents.
product_name.proof: Lab report sample description, tech pack, or BOM header.

sku.label: SKU
sku.what: Exact article / model / SAP code identifying this product.
sku.proof: Lab report header, brand material code, or BOM line.

upper_material.label: Upper material
upper_material.what: Main material of the shoe upper (e.g. full-grain leather, textile).
upper_material.proof: Supplier material declaration or lab composition claim.

upper_composition.label: Upper composition
upper_composition.what: Material breakdown of the upper with shares (e.g. Leather 80%, textile 20%).
upper_composition.proof: Lab report 'composition claimed' box or supplier declaration.

leather_origin.label: Leather origin
leather_origin.what: Country or region where the leather itself comes from — only counts when a document ties origin to leather, never a generic country of origin.

sole_material.label: Sole material
sole_material.what: Outsole material as printed (e.g. synthetic rubber, EVA).
sole_material.proof: Lab report composition claim or sole supplier declaration.

reach_compliance.label: REACH compliance
reach_compliance.what: A statement about THIS product respecting REACH (Reg. 1907/2006) — a declaration, certificate, or PASS verdict. A rulebook mention is not compliance.
reach_compliance.proof: Supplier REACH declaration or accredited lab PASS report.
